question: If x⁴+{1over x⁴}=34 where x>0, then find the value of x +{1over x}.
solution:
**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

The given equation can be rearranged as-

⇒ (x²)²+({1over x²})² +2 × x² × {1over x²}=34+2

⇒ (x² + 1over x²)² = 36

Taking square root both sides of the equation, we get-

⇒ x2 + 1over x² = 6

Again rearranging the equation as given below-

⇒ x² + 1over x² + 2 × x × 1over x = 6 + 2

⇒ (x + 1over x )² = 8

Taking square root both sides, we get-

⇒ x + 1over x = √8 or 2√2

∴** The value of ****​x +{1over x}​ is 2√2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** If x⁴ + 1over x⁴ = n then

x² + 1over x² = sqrt{n+2} = p

x + 1over x = sqrt{p+2}

Now,

x² + 1over x² = sqrt{34+2} = sqrt36 = 6

And, x + 1over x = sqrt{6+2} = sqrt8 = 2sqrt2 

**∴ The value of x + 1over x is 2sqrt2.**
